title: Augmentation & Mixup
tagline: Two cheap ways to invent training data: scatter neighbors around each point, or place soft-labeled points along the lines between them
summary: A 2-D two-class dataset with only twelve points per class gives a nervous, jagged decision boundary. Toggle data augmentation and watch each example sprout a cloud of jittered copies that thickens the support and straightens the boundary. Toggle mixup and watch convex combinations x = lambda*xi + (1-lambda)*xj carry soft labels along the segments between examples, widening the pale margin band. A lambda slider slides a highlighted blended point between an A example and a B example, colored by its interpolated soft label. Both fill in the data manifold and push the boundary to a larger margin.
highlights: Toggle data augmentation and watch every point sprout a cloud of jittered copies that thickens class support and straightens the boundary.
Toggle mixup and see soft-labeled convex combinations bridge the gap between classes along straight segments.
Drag a lambda slider to slide a highlighted blended point x = lambda*xi + (1-lambda)*xj between two classes, colored by its interpolated soft label.
Watch a live decision landscape with a pale margin ribbon widen as mixup forces the prediction to change linearly between examples.
Read three metrics live: effective example count, margin-band area, and decision-boundary length that quantify the smoothing.
